body: FIXTURE FINDING: multilingual.csv is a coherent per-row-locale table (locale+country columns; price format matches each row's country). NOT a torture test — realistic international dataset. Do NOT mutate its price (would desync from locale/country). Plan: add a separate single-locale euro fixture for the selector; leave multilingual.csv multi-locale with an honest expected output. ac-02 revised accordingly.

ac-02 MANUFACTURE done. Extended scripts/mining_factory/manufacture.py with two generators: (1) manufacture_currency_amounts — 10 amount_* format variants from deterministic CLDR number-format rules (per-locale grouping/decimal/symbol-position, multi-symbol for format-not-symbol learning), each formatter verified 300/300 against its taxonomy validator; (2) manufacture_datetime_locale_dates — long_full_month/weekday_full_month/weekday_abbreviated_month composed from CLDR month+weekday names, Latin-script-filtered (the [A-Za-z] validator). Fixed a draw-twice bug (validated one random weekday, emitted another). Added all 13 to ALL_TIER1_TYPES. Full pipeline validated: manufacture 181k rows -> precision funnel 143k survive (drops are correct collision-resolution, amount_comma_suffix subset of amount_comma) -> leakage firewall 137k clean. Every new type clears the 50-distinct floor by orders of magnitude (amounts 400-800 distinct, datetime 2800-4150). Outputs (gitignored) under output/mining-factory/locale-format/. NEXT: blend into distilled corpus (mining-factory ac-04 materialise) -> destination-drift proxy pre-check -> overnight train BOTH --model-type {char-cnn, multi-branch} (ac-03 probe) -> gates (ac-04).
